title: Supportive periodontal therapy (SPT) in perisistent periodontal pockets with vs. without adjunctive protocol.
summary: Comparison of outcome 12 months after therapy carried out either with or without adjunctive protocol.

interventions.name:

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Documented history of at least 4 previous SPT visits and at least 1 year of SPT treatment with yet persistent periodontal pockets >=5 mm in probing depth and bleeding (BOP+)
Smokers, D.melitus medication, CHD medications included.
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy/lactating
SPT program lasting for less than 1 year
PPD <5 mm
No signs of bleeding on probing (BOP-)
Demencia, cognitive impairment, Antiresorptiv medication (Denosumab, Bisphosphonates, etc.)
